title: Timer plasmoid: add stopwatch mode
line: The Timer widget gains a Stopwatch mode with Start, Pause and Reset.
explanation: The Timer widget could only count down, so measuring elapsed time needed a separate widget. Open MR kdeplasma-addons!1289 by Peder Bergan adds a Timer/Stopwatch selector to the popup and context menu, a stopwatch backed by a monotonic clock with Start, Pause and Reset, shown as hh:mm:ss in the panel and popup; the stopwatch value is saved per widget and restored paused.

commits.message:
applets/timer: Add stopwatch mode

Add per-applet count-up timing with start, pause and reset in the widget
and context menu. Pause when changing modes and restore saved stopwatch
time paused. Use a monotonic clock and refresh at elapsed-second boundaries.

BUG: 518984
